children: The yield on the 10-year Treasury rose as high as 5.043% this morning-rocketing past the 5.026% level it reached earlier this month.
That's the highest level it's reached since July 2007. Yields jumped across the curve, and European bonds sold off as well.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
